messages:
sam_p: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime segment. Can we capture owners and short-term mitigations for the tail latency issues?

maria_r: Short-term: triage top p99 regressions on high-concurrency routes. Owner: maria_r + joel_s. ETA: 7 days.

kai_w: Root cause looks like batching mixing very long and very short seqs -> KV misses and larger tails. I can prototype a small batching window cap and seq-length bucketing (8-12ms) this week.

jen_l: From model side, quant fallback chooses slower kernels intermittently. Medium-term: kernel compatibility map + ordered fallback. Owner: jen_l + eng-runtime. ETA: 3-4 weeks.

joel_s: Ops: upping trace sampling to 10% for affected routes so we get kernel+cache correlation. Will open runbook PR.

sam_p: Any temporary workarounds product teams can use now?

maria_r: Add header X-RW-ServeHint: low_latency to force split-by-length routing to low-latency variant; falls back if unavailable. We'll document in Console.

kai_w: Also advise prefer_cached: true for stable prompts to hit KV cache.

sam_p: Risks for batching cap?

maria_r: Risk: smaller batches -> higher CPU/cost. Rollout plan: FF canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%, quick revert via flag.

kai_w: Pseudo config: batching.window_ms=10, split_strategy=seq_len_buckets.

jen_l: Measurables: short-term reduce p99 incidents by >=60% for model-alpha. Medium-term 15-25% p99 improvement after kernel ordering.

joel_s: ACTIONS: triage & hotfix (maria_r+joel_s) ETA 7d; batching FF prototype (kai_w) ETA 5d; kernel map + eval hooks (jen_l) ETA 3-4w; trace sampling + runbook (joel_s) ETA 3d.

sam_p: I'll create a GH project and link these. Please post PR links when started. Thanks. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: canary deploy 1909876800 started by kai_w  status: running

kai_w: Update after 20m: canary at 5% shows improved tail on sampled routes. Posting traces to #eng-runtime shortly. :eyes:
